_how: Where to find things, for 'where' questions. One short line each, written for Bedrock and checked against the Minecraft Wiki (the page is in 'wiki'). 'also': other ids that get the same line. 'guide': a guide to offer with it. 'build': a mob you make, so 'how do I make one' gets this line too. Places are structures you can find; 'pic' is the item shown for one, 'askedAs' the ways kids say it. The build copies the lines into the book without the links.

allay.say: Allays are found in wooden cages at [pillager outposts](place:pillager_outpost) and in [woodland mansions](place:woodland_mansion).

axolotl.say: Axolotls live in [lush caves](biome:lush_caves), in the water underground.

bee.say: Bees live in [bee nests](item:bee_nest) that hang from trees, often near flowers.

blaze.say: Blazes live in Nether fortresses, around blaze spawners.

bogged.say: Bogged live in [swamps](biome:swamp) and [mangrove swamps](biome:mangrove_swamp), and in [trial chambers](place:trial_chambers).

breeze.say: Breezes come out of trial spawners in [trial chambers](place:trial_chambers), deep underground.

camel.say: Camels live in [deserts](biome:desert), and there's one in the middle of each desert [village](place:village).

camel_husk.say: Camel husks show up in [deserts](biome:desert), with a [husk](mob:husk) and a parched riding on them.

cat.say: Cats live in [villages](place:village) and at [swamp huts](place:swamp_hut).

cave_spider.say: Cave spiders live in [mineshafts](place:mineshaft), around cave spider spawners.

chicken.say: Chickens live in grassy places, like [plains](biome:plains) and [forests](biome:forest).

copper_golem.say: You build a copper golem: put a [carved pumpkin](item:carved_pumpkin) on top of a copper block.

cow.say: Cows live in grassy places, like [plains](biome:plains) and [forests](biome:forest).

creaking.say: Creakings come out at night from a [creaking heart](item:creaking_heart), inside a pale oak tree in the [pale garden](biome:pale_garden).

creeper.say: Creepers come out in the dark, at night and in caves.

dolphin.say: Dolphins swim in most [oceans](biome:ocean), but not frozen or cold ones.

elder_guardian.say: Elder guardians live in [ocean monuments](place:ocean_monument). Each monument has 3, and they never come back.

enderman.say: Endermen come out in the dark in the Overworld, and they live in the Nether and the End too.

endermite.say: Endermites sometimes pop out when you throw an [ender pearl](item:ender_pearl).

ender_dragon.say: The Ender Dragon lives in the End. Find a [stronghold](place:stronghold) and go through its End portal.

evoker.say: Evokers live in [woodland mansions](place:woodland_mansion), and they show up in raids on [villages](place:village).

fox.say: Foxes live in [taiga](biome:taiga) [forests](biome:forest), with the spruce trees.

ghast.say: Ghasts float around the Nether, in [soul sand valleys](biome:soul_sand_valley), [Nether wastes](biome:nether_wastes) and [basalt deltas](biome:basalt_deltas).

happy_ghast.say: Grow one from a [dried ghast](item:dried_ghast): put it in water. Dried ghasts are found in [soul sand valleys](biome:soul_sand_valley) in the Nether.

glow_squid.say: Glow squid swim in dark water deep underground.

goat.say: Goats live high up in snowy mountains.

guardian.say: Guardians live in and around [ocean monuments](place:ocean_monument).

hoglin.say: Hoglins live in [crimson forests](biome:crimson_forest) and [bastions](place:bastion), in the Nether.

husk.say: Husks come out in [deserts](biome:desert), in place of most [zombies](mob:zombie).

iron_golem.say: Iron golems guard [villages](place:village). You can also build one: 4 iron blocks in a T shape with a [carved pumpkin](item:carved_pumpkin) on top.

magma_cube.say: Magma cubes live in the Nether, most of all in [basalt deltas](biome:basalt_deltas).

mooshroom.say: Mooshrooms only live in [mushroom fields](biome:mushroom_fields), a rare island biome.

mule.say: Mules don't spawn on their own. Breed a [horse](mob:horse) with a [donkey](mob:donkey) to get one.

panda.say: Pandas live in [jungles](biome:jungle), most of all in [bamboo jungles](biome:bamboo_jungle).

parched.say: Parched come out in [deserts](biome:desert). They're a kind of [skeleton](mob:skeleton).

phantom.say: Phantoms come out at night if you haven't slept for 3 days or more.

pig.say: Pigs live in grassy places, like [plains](biome:plains) and [forests](biome:forest).

piglin.say: Piglins live in the Nether, in [Nether wastes](biome:nether_wastes), [crimson forests](biome:crimson_forest) and [bastions](place:bastion).

piglin_brute.say: Piglin brutes only live in [bastions](place:bastion), in the Nether.

pillager.say: Pillagers live at [pillager outposts](place:pillager_outpost), walk around in patrols, and come in raids on [villages](place:village).

polar_bear.say: Polar bears live in [snowy plains](biome:snowy_plains), [ice spikes](biome:ice_spikes) and [frozen oceans](biome:frozen_ocean).

pufferfish.say: Pufferfish swim in warm and [lukewarm oceans](biome:lukewarm_ocean).

rabbit.say: Rabbits live in [deserts](biome:desert), [flower forests](biome:flower_forest), [taigas](biome:taiga) and snowy places.

sheep.say: Sheep live in grassy places, like [plains](biome:plains) and [forests](biome:forest).

shulker.say: Shulkers live in [End cities](place:end_city), out on the End's outer islands.

silverfish.say: Silverfish hide inside [stone](item:stone) blocks in [strongholds](place:stronghold) and mountains, and pop out when you break them.

skeleton.say: Skeletons come out in the dark, at night and in caves.

skeleton_horse.say: Skeleton horses show up as a trap when lightning strikes in a thunderstorm.

slime.say: Slimes come out in [swamps](biome:swamp) at night, and deep underground in some places called slime chunks.

sniffer.say: Sniffers hatch from [sniffer eggs](item:sniffer_egg). Find the eggs in [suspicious sand](item:suspicious_sand) at warm [ocean ruins](place:ocean_ruins).

snow_golem.say: You build a snow golem: put a [carved pumpkin](item:carved_pumpkin) on top of 2 [snow blocks](item:snow_block).

spider.say: Spiders come out in the dark, at night and in caves.

stray.say: Strays come out in snowy places, in place of most [skeletons](mob:skeleton).

strider.say: Striders walk on the lava seas in the Nether.

tadpole.say: Tadpoles hatch from frogspawn, the eggs [frogs](mob:frog) lay in water.

trader_llama.say: Trader llamas come with the wandering trader.

tropical_fish.say: Tropical fish swim in warm and [lukewarm oceans](biome:lukewarm_ocean).

vex.say: Vexes only show up when an [evoker](mob:evoker) calls them.

vindicator.say: Vindicators live in [woodland mansions](place:woodland_mansion), and they show up in raids on [villages](place:village).

warden.say: The warden lives in the [deep dark](biome:deep_dark), far underground. [Sculk](item:sculk) shriekers call it, so sneak around them.

witch.say: Witches come out in the dark, and one lives in each [swamp hut](place:swamp_hut).

wither.say: The wither is a boss you build: 4 [soul sand](item:soul_sand) in a T shape with 3 [wither skeleton skulls](item:wither_skeleton_skull) on top.

wither_skeleton.say: Wither skeletons live in Nether fortresses.

zoglin.say: A zoglin is a [hoglin](mob:hoglin) that left the Nether. Hoglins turn into zoglins in the Overworld.

zombie.say: Zombies come out in the dark, at night and in caves.

zombie_horse.say: Zombie horses are rare. Some come at night in [plains](biome:plains) and [savannas](biome:savanna), with a [zombie](mob:zombie) riding them.

zombie_nautilus.say: [Zombie](mob:zombie) nautiluses swim in [oceans](biome:ocean), with a [drowned](mob:drowned) riding them.

zombie_villager.say: Some [zombies](mob:zombie) are zombie villagers. A zombie can also turn a villager into one.

zombified_piglin.say: Zombified piglins live in the Nether, and sometimes show up near Nether portals.

diamond.say: Diamonds are deep underground. Look around level -59, near the bottom of the world.

raw_iron.say: Iron ore is in [stone](item:stone) underground and in mountains. Level 16 is a good place to look.

raw_gold.say: Gold ore is deep underground, around level -16, and there's lots in [badlands](biome:badlands).

nether_gold_ore.say: Nether gold ore is all over the Nether. It gives you [gold nuggets](item:gold_nugget).

coal.say: Coal ore is easy to find in [stone](item:stone), in caves and high up in mountains.

raw_copper.say: Copper ore is in [stone](item:stone) underground, most around level 48, and lots in [dripstone caves](biome:dripstone_caves).

redstone.say: Redstone ore is deep underground, near the bottom of the world.

lapis_lazuli.say: Lapis lazuli ore is underground, most around level 0.

emerald.say: Emerald ore is only in mountains. You can also get emeralds by trading with villagers.

ancient_debris.say: Ancient debris is in the Nether, most around level 16. You need a [diamond pickaxe](item:diamond_pickaxe) to mine it.

netherite_scrap.say: Netherite scrap comes from [ancient debris](item:ancient_debris), deep in the Nether. Smelt the debris in a [furnace](item:furnace).

quartz.say: Nether quartz ore is all over the Nether.

amethyst_shard.say: Amethyst is inside [amethyst geodes](place:amethyst_geode), round caves of purple crystal underground.

budding_amethyst.say: Budding amethyst is inside [amethyst geodes](place:amethyst_geode). It breaks if you mine it, even with Silk Touch.

obsidian.say: Obsidian forms where water flows onto still lava. You can also find it at [ruined portals](place:ruined_portal).

elytra.say: Elytra are in [End cities](place:end_city), in an [item frame](item:item_frame) on the End ship. Beat the [Ender Dragon](mob:ender_dragon) first.

trident.say: Tridents come from [drowned](mob:drowned). Some drowned hold one, and they might drop it when you beat them.

totem_of_undying.say: [Evokers](mob:evoker) always drop a totem of undying. Find them in [woodland mansions](place:woodland_mansion) and in raids.

heart_of_the_sea.say: The heart of the sea is in [buried treasure](place:buried_treasure) [chests](item:chest) on [beaches](biome:beach). Treasure maps from [shipwrecks](place:shipwreck) and [ocean ruins](place:ocean_ruins) show where.

nautilus_shell.say: [Drowned](mob:drowned) holding a nautilus shell can drop it. You can also fish one up or trade for one.

sponge.say: Sponges are in sponge rooms in [ocean monuments](place:ocean_monument). [Elder guardians](mob:elder_guardian) drop [wet sponges](item:wet_sponge) too.

saddle.say: You can craft a saddle. You can also find saddles in [chests](item:chest), fish one up, or trade for one.

name_tag.say: You can craft a name tag. You can also find them in [chests](item:chest), fish one up, or trade for one.

echo_shard.say: Echo shards are in [chests](item:chest) in [ancient cities](place:ancient_city), in the [deep dark](biome:deep_dark).

trial_key.say: Trial keys come from trial spawners in [trial chambers](place:trial_chambers), after you beat their mobs.

heavy_core.say: Heavy cores are in ominous vaults in [trial chambers](place:trial_chambers). They're rare.

enchanted_golden_apple.say: Enchanted golden apples are rare finds in [chests](item:chest), like in [mineshafts](place:mineshaft), [dungeons](place:monster_room), [desert pyramids](place:desert_pyramid) and [ruined portals](place:ruined_portal).

dragon_egg.say: The dragon egg shows up on top of the portal in the End after you beat the [Ender Dragon](mob:ender_dragon).

slime_ball.say: Slimes drop slimeballs. Find slimes in [swamps](biome:swamp) at night.

ender_pearl.say: [Endermen](mob:enderman) drop ender pearls. You can also trade with villagers for them.

blaze_rod.say: [Blazes](mob:blaze) drop blaze rods. Blazes live in Nether fortresses.

ghast_tear.say: [Ghasts](mob:ghast) drop ghast tears. Find ghasts flying around the Nether.

shulker_shell.say: [Shulkers](mob:shulker) drop shulker shells. They live in [End cities](place:end_city).

wither_skeleton_skull.say: [Wither skeletons](mob:wither_skeleton) sometimes drop their skull. They live in Nether fortresses.

breeze_rod.say: [Breezes](mob:breeze) drop breeze rods. They're in [trial chambers](place:trial_chambers).

armadillo_scute.say: [Armadillos](mob:armadillo) drop a scute now and then. [Brush](item:brush) an armadillo to get one.

goat_horn.say: [Goats](mob:goat) drop a horn when they ram into [stone](item:stone), [logs](item:oak_log), ore or [packed ice](item:packed_ice). [Pillager outposts](place:pillager_outpost) have them too.

sniffer_egg.say: Sniffer eggs are in [suspicious sand](item:suspicious_sand) at warm [ocean ruins](place:ocean_ruins). Use a [brush](item:brush) to dig them out.

turtle_egg.say: [Turtles](mob:turtle) lay turtle eggs on [beaches](biome:beach) after you feed them [seagrass](item:seagrass).

honeycomb.say: Use [shears](item:shears) on a full [bee nest](item:bee_nest) or [beehive](item:beehive). Put a [campfire](item:campfire) under it first so the [bees](mob:bee) stay calm.

sugar_cane.say: Sugar cane grows next to water, on [sand](item:sand), [dirt](item:dirt) or grass.

pumpkin.say: Pumpkins grow in small patches in grassy places.

bamboo.say: Bamboo grows in [jungles](biome:jungle), most of all in [bamboo jungles](biome:bamboo_jungle).

cocoa_beans.say: Cocoa beans grow in pods on the sides of [jungle](biome:jungle) trees. Break a pod when it turns orange.

oak_log.say: Logs come from trees. Chop the trunk of any tree.

sand.say: Sand is in [deserts](biome:desert), on [beaches](biome:beach), and on the bottom of [rivers](biome:river) and [oceans](biome:ocean).

gravel.say: Gravel is underground, on [beaches](biome:beach), and on the bottom of [oceans](biome:ocean).

clay_ball.say: Clay is on the bottom of lakes, [rivers](biome:river) and [swamps](biome:swamp).

nether_wart.say: Nether wart grows in Nether fortresses and [bastions](place:bastion).

glowstone_dust.say: Glowstone hangs from the ceiling in the Nether. Break it to get glowstone dust.

dried_ghast.say: Dried ghasts are in [soul sand valleys](biome:soul_sand_valley) in the Nether, next to big [bone](item:bone) fossils. You can also make one.

pointed_dripstone.say: Pointed dripstone grows in [dripstone caves](biome:dripstone_caves), underground.

mud.say: Mud is in [mangrove swamps](biome:mangrove_swamp). You can also make it: use a water bottle on [dirt](item:dirt).

milk_bucket.say: Use an empty [bucket](item:bucket) on a [cow](mob:cow), a [goat](mob:goat) or a [mooshroom](mob:mooshroom) to fill it with milk.

water_bucket.say: Use an empty [bucket](item:bucket) on water to fill it.

bell.say: Bells are in [villages](place:village), at the meeting place in the middle.

spawner.say: Spawners are in [dungeons](place:monster_room), [mineshafts](place:mineshaft), Nether fortresses, [strongholds](place:stronghold) and [woodland mansions](place:woodland_mansion). You can't pick one up.

dandelion.say: Dandelions are yellow flowers that grow on grass in most places, mostly in [plains](biome:plains).

warped_fungus.say: Warped fungus grows in [warped forests](biome:warped_forest) in the Nether.

crimson_fungus.say: Crimson fungus grows in [crimson forests](biome:crimson_forest) in the Nether.

tropical_fish_bucket.say: Use a [water bucket](item:water_bucket) on a [tropical fish](mob:tropical_fish) swimming in water to catch it.

firework_rocket.say: Craft [paper](item:paper) with [gunpowder](item:gunpowder) to make 3 firework rockets. More gunpowder, up to 3, makes them fly longer.

enchanted_book.say: Enchant a [book](item:book) on an [enchanting table](item:enchanting_table), catch one fishing, trade with a librarian villager, or find one in [chests](item:chest).

rabbit_foot.say: [Rabbits](mob:rabbit) sometimes drop a rabbit's foot. A tamed [cat](mob:cat) may also bring you one as a [gift](mob:cat#gifts).

bee_nest.say: Bee nests hang from trees. Every tree in a [meadow](biome:meadow) has one, and some trees in [plains](biome:plains), [flower forests](biome:flower_forest) and [cherry groves](biome:cherry_grove) do too.

suspicious_sand.say: Suspicious sand is under [desert pyramids](place:desert_pyramid), at the bottom of [desert](biome:desert) wells, and in warm [ocean ruins](place:ocean_ruins).

suspicious_gravel.say: Suspicious gravel is in cold [ocean ruins](place:ocean_ruins) and [trail ruins](place:trail_ruins).

carved_pumpkin.say: Use [shears](item:shears) on a [pumpkin](item:pumpkin) to carve a face in it. You get 4 [pumpkin seeds](item:pumpkin_seeds) too.

farmland.say: Use a [hoe](item:wooden_hoe) on [dirt](item:dirt) or grass to make farmland. Crops grow on it, faster when water is near.

ice.say: Ice covers [frozen rivers](biome:frozen_river) and lakes in snowy places. Mine it with a Silk Touch [pickaxe](item:wooden_pickaxe), or it melts.

potion.say: Make potions at a [brewing stand](item:brewing_stand), starting with water bottles. [Witches](mob:witch) drop them sometimes too.

sculk.say: Sculk covers the ground in the [deep dark](biome:deep_dark), far underground.

soul_sand.say: Soul sand is in the Nether, most of all in [soul sand valleys](biome:soul_sand_valley). Nether fortresses have some too.

sweet_berry_bush.say: Sweet berry bushes grow in [taigas](biome:taiga). Pick the berries when they turn red, and watch out: the bushes scratch.

oak_leaves.say: Leaves grow on trees. Break them with [shears](item:shears) to keep them: anything else only drops a [sapling](item:oak_sapling) or a [stick](item:stick) now and then. Leaves you place never fall.

vine.say: Vines hang from trees in [jungles](biome:jungle) and [swamps](biome:swamp). Cut them with [shears](item:shears) to keep them.

splash_potion.say: Add [gunpowder](item:gunpowder) to a [potion](item:potion) in a [brewing stand](item:brewing_stand) to make a splash potion that you throw.

nether_star.say: Defeating the [Wither](mob:wither) drops a nether star. It is a very strong boss, so get help.

calcite.say: Calcite is the white [stone](item:stone) layer in [amethyst geodes](place:amethyst_geode), deep underground.

cornflower.say: Cornflowers are blue flowers that grow in [plains](biome:plains), [flower forests](biome:flower_forest) and [meadows](biome:meadow).

stronghold.name: Stronghold
stronghold.say: Strongholds are hidden underground. Throw an [eye of ender](item:ender_eye): it flies toward the nearest one.

woodland_mansion.name: Woodland mansion
woodland_mansion.say: Woodland mansions are in [dark forests](biome:dark_forest) and [pale gardens](biome:pale_garden). They're rare and far away, so a map from a cartographer villager helps.

ocean_monument.name: Ocean monument
ocean_monument.say: Ocean monuments are underwater in [deep oceans](biome:deep_ocean).

nether_fortress.name: Nether fortress
nether_fortress.say: Nether fortresses are in the Nether, in any biome. They're made of dark [Nether bricks](item:nether_bricks).

bastion.name: Bastion
bastion.say: Bastions are in the Nether, in every biome but [basalt deltas](biome:basalt_deltas). They're full of [piglins](mob:piglin) and gold.

end_city.name: End city
end_city.say: End cities are on the End's outer islands. Beat the [Ender Dragon](mob:ender_dragon), then go through the small gateway portal.

ancient_city.name: Ancient city
ancient_city.say: Ancient cities are in the [deep dark](biome:deep_dark), far underground, often under mountains.

trial_chambers.name: Trial chambers
trial_chambers.say: Trial chambers are underground, around level -40 to -20.

pillager_outpost.name: Pillager outpost
pillager_outpost.say: Pillager outposts are dark wooden towers in the same kinds of places as [villages](place:village), but rarer.

desert_pyramid.name: Desert pyramid
desert_pyramid.say: Desert pyramids are in [deserts](biome:desert). Watch out for the trap under the treasure room.

jungle_pyramid.name: Jungle temple
jungle_pyramid.say: Jungle temples are in [jungles](biome:jungle). Watch out for the traps inside.

swamp_hut.name: Swamp hut
swamp_hut.say: Swamp huts are in [swamps](biome:swamp). A [witch](mob:witch) and a black [cat](mob:cat) live there.

igloo.name: Igloo
igloo.say: Igloos are in [snowy plains](biome:snowy_plains) and [snowy taigas](biome:snowy_taiga). Some have a secret basement.

buried_treasure.name: Buried treasure
buried_treasure.say: Buried treasure is under the [sand](item:sand) on [beaches](biome:beach). Treasure maps from [shipwrecks](place:shipwreck) and [ocean ruins](place:ocean_ruins) show where.

ruined_portal.name: Ruined portal
ruined_portal.say: Ruined portals are all over the Overworld and the Nether.

mineshaft.name: Mineshaft
mineshaft.say: Mineshafts are underground, with [rails](item:rail) and wooden beams. In [badlands](biome:badlands) some are above ground.

monster_room.name: Dungeon
monster_room.say: Dungeons are small mossy rooms underground with a mob spawner and [chests](item:chest).

trail_ruins.name: Trail ruins
trail_ruins.say: Trail ruins are buried in [taigas](biome:taiga), [jungles](biome:jungle) and old [birch forests](biome:birch_forest). [Brush](item:brush) the [suspicious gravel](item:suspicious_gravel) to find treasure.

amethyst_geode.name: Amethyst geode
amethyst_geode.say: Amethyst geodes are underground, from deep down up to level 30.

nether_fossil.name: Nether fossil
nether_fossil.say: Nether fossils are big [bones](item:bone) in [soul sand valleys](biome:soul_sand_valley), in the Nether.

ocean_ruins.name: Ocean ruins
ocean_ruins.say: Ocean ruins are on the [ocean](biome:ocean) floor. [Warm oceans](biome:warm_ocean) have [sandstone](item:sandstone) ones and [cold oceans](biome:cold_ocean) have [stone](item:stone) ones.
